blocks.zh: 第三部分7–8節：物料系統與生產系統
blocks.en: Part 3, Sections 7-8: Materials System and Production System

blocks.zh: 📋 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 📋 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 WFI 系統查廠的六大重點（死角、坡度、Alert/Action Level、趨勢數據）
blocks.en: Master the six key focus areas of a WFI system inspection (dead legs, slope, Alert/Action Levels, trend data)

blocks.zh: 了解容器/密封系統完整性（CCI）的驗證要求（穩定性測試中以 CCI 取代無菌測試）
blocks.en: Understand the validation requirements for container/closure integrity (CCI), which replaces sterility testing in stability studies

blocks.zh: 理解培養基模擬試驗（APS/Media Fill）的設計要求與查廠期待（半年一次/每班次）
blocks.en: Understand the design requirements for media fills (APS/process simulations) and inspection expectations (every six months / each shift)

blocks.zh: 掌握除菌過濾（Sterile Filtration）、除熱原（Depyrogenation）、最終滅菌的關鍵查廠要點
blocks.en: Master the key inspection points for sterile filtration, depyrogenation, and terminal sterilization

blocks.zh: 了解 100% 目視檢查（Visual Inspection）的查廠關注焦點與人員資格要求
blocks.en: Understand the inspection focus for 100% visual inspection and the personnel qualification requirements

blocks.zh: 識別參數放行（Parametric Release）的適用條件與法規依據
blocks.en: Identify the applicability conditions and regulatory basis for parametric release

blocks.zh: 3.7 Materials System 物料系統
blocks.en: 3.7 Materials System

blocks.zh: 📘 物料系統解讀 — 無菌保障從物料開始
blocks.en: 📘 Materials System Interpretation: Sterility Assurance Starts with Materials

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 採購進廠的預洗塞——藥廠仍需負責
blocks.en: ⚠️ Purchased Pre-Washed Stoppers: The Firm Remains Responsible

blocks.zh: 即使向廠商購買「Ready-to-Sterilize」（預清洗無熱原）的橡皮塞，藥廠仍須：
blocks.en: Even when ready-to-sterilize (pre-washed, depyrogenated) rubber stoppers are purchased from a supplier, the firm must still:

blocks.zh: 在規格書中納入熱原要求
blocks.en: Include pyrogen requirements in the specification

blocks.zh: 若不每批次自行測試，須通過廠商資格確認（Vendor Qualification）建立對廠商測試結果的信任基礎
blocks.en: If it does not test every lot itself, establish trust in the supplier's test results through vendor qualification

blocks.zh: 定期進行驗收測試以確認廠商持續合規
blocks.en: Perform periodic acceptance testing to confirm the supplier remains compliant

blocks.zh: 這是查廠時常被忽視的責任歸屬問題——委外不等於免責。
blocks.en: This is a frequently overlooked question of accountability during inspections: outsourcing does not transfer responsibility.

blocks.zh: CCI 取代無菌測試的法規依據
blocks.en: Regulatory Basis for Replacing Sterility Testing with CCI

blocks.zh: FDA 允許在產品穩定性計畫中以容器密封完整性測試（CCI）取代無菌測試。前提：
blocks.en: FDA allows container closure integrity (CCI) testing to replace sterility testing in the product stability program, provided that:

blocks.zh: CCI 方法需在驗證研究中確認靈敏度
blocks.en: The sensitivity of the CCI method is confirmed in validation studies

blocks.zh: 測試需涵蓋最大滅菌循環次數的壓力條件
blocks.en: Testing covers the stress conditions of the maximum number of sterilization cycles

blocks.zh: 需覆蓋整個產品儲存期
blocks.en: Testing covers the entire product shelf life

blocks.zh: 查廠時 FDA 會確認：驗證設計是否真正模擬了最壞情況（包含滅菌、運輸、儲存應力）。
blocks.en: During an inspection, FDA will confirm whether the validation design truly simulates worst-case conditions (including sterilization, shipping, and storage stresses).

blocks.zh: 💡 製程氣體的「隱形風險」
blocks.en: 💡 The "Hidden Risk" of Process Gases

blocks.zh: 氮氣覆蓋（Nitrogen Overlay）是氧敏感產品的保護措施，但若氮氣未通過除菌過濾，反而成為微生物污染途徑。查廠官員會確認：所有在滅菌下游或無菌操作中接觸產品的氣體，是否通過疏水性除菌過濾（0.22 μm），並有完整性測試記錄。
blocks.en: Nitrogen overlay is a protective measure for oxygen-sensitive products, but if the nitrogen is not sterile filtered, it becomes a route of microbial contamination. Investigators will confirm that all gases that contact the product downstream of sterilization or during aseptic operations pass through a hydrophobic sterilizing filter (0.22 μm) with filter integrity test records.

blocks.zh: 🏭 物料系統查廠準備要點
blocks.en: 🏭 Key Preparation Points for Materials System Inspection

blocks.zh: WFI 等距圖：確保為最新版本，標示所有採樣點、死角長度、坡度
blocks.en: WFI isometric drawings: Ensure they are current and show all sampling points, dead leg lengths, and slopes

blocks.zh: WFI/PW 趨勢報告：TOC、電導度、微生物、內毒素，含 Alert/Action Level 及超標調查
blocks.en: WFI/PW trend reports: TOC, conductivity, microbial counts, and endotoxin, including Alert/Action Levels and excursion investigations

blocks.zh: 廠商資格確認：預洗塞廠商的 QA Agreement 和定期驗收測試記錄
blocks.en: Vendor qualification: The QA agreement with the pre-washed stopper supplier and periodic acceptance testing records

blocks.zh: CCI 驗證資料：方法靈敏度、最壞情況設計、穩定性 CCI 數據
blocks.en: CCI validation data: Method sensitivity, worst-case design, and CCI data from stability studies

blocks.zh: 製程氣體過濾器：完整性測試記錄，包含每批使用後的測試
blocks.en: Process gas filters: Integrity test records, including post-use testing for every batch

blocks.zh: 3.8 Production System 生產系統
blocks.en: 3.8 Production System

blocks.zh: 📘 生產系統解讀 — 現場觀察是核心
blocks.en: 📘 Production System Interpretation: Direct Observation Is the Core

blocks.zh: 為什麼「現場觀察」不可取代？
blocks.en: Why Is "Direct Observation" Irreplaceable?

blocks.zh: FDA 強調生產系統查廠必須包含製程的即時觀察（Real-Time Observation）。原因：
blocks.en: FDA emphasizes that a production system inspection must include real-time observation of the process. The reasons:

blocks.zh: 許多無菌操作缺失只在「現場進行時」才看得到（如操作人員跨越無菌區、設備卡住時的不當處置）
blocks.en: Many aseptic operation deficiencies are visible only while the operation is under way (for example, an operator reaching over the aseptic area, or improper handling when equipment jams)

blocks.zh: SOP 寫得完美，但實際執行可能偏離
blocks.en: The SOP may be perfectly written, yet actual execution can deviate from it

blocks.zh: 文件查核只能看到「應該怎麼做」，觀察才能看到「實際怎麼做」
blocks.en: A document review shows only "what should be done"; observation shows "what is actually done"

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 最高風險操作：干預（Interventions）
blocks.en: ⚠️ The Highest-Risk Operations: Interventions

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員會特別關注非計畫性干預（如設備卡塞、操作員臨時更換零件）。這類事件：
blocks.en: FDA investigators pay particular attention to unplanned interventions (such as equipment jams or an operator replacing a part on the spot). Such events:

blocks.zh: 必須記錄在批次記錄中
blocks.en: Must be recorded in the batch record

blocks.zh: 應在 Media Fill 中模擬（作為 Worst Case Interventions）
blocks.en: Should be simulated in the media fill (as worst-case interventions)

blocks.zh: 需要評估對無菌性的影響
blocks.en: Must be evaluated for their impact on sterility

blocks.zh: 觀察到操作員在未記錄的情況下進行干預，是重大缺失。
blocks.en: Observing an operator perform an unrecorded intervention is a significant deficiency.

blocks.zh: 💡 凍乾產品的「全程 ISO 5 原則」
blocks.en: 💡 The "ISO 5 Throughout" Principle for Lyophilized Products

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品從填充、半塞、轉移到凍乾機裝載、凍乾循環中的塞瓶，整個過程半塞瓶的無菌產品持續暴露於環境。FDA 要求全程均在 Class 100 (ISO 5) 條件下——這意味著轉移走廊、凍乾機裝載區域都需要 ISO 5 保護。
blocks.en: For lyophilized products, from filling and partial stoppering through transfer, loading into the lyophilizer, and stoppering during the lyophilization cycle, the sterile product in partially stoppered vials remains exposed to the environment throughout. FDA requires that the entire process be conducted under Class 100 (ISO 5) conditions, which means the transfer corridor and the lyophilizer loading area both need ISO 5 protection.

blocks.zh: 3.8 Production — Critical Operations 關鍵操作查廠
blocks.en: 3.8 Production: Critical Operations Inspection

blocks.zh: (1) Media Fills / Process Simulations（培養基模擬試驗）
blocks.en: (1) Media Fills / Process Simulations

blocks.zh: (2) Sterile Filtration（除菌過濾）
blocks.en: (2) Sterile Filtration

blocks.zh: 📘 關鍵操作解讀
blocks.en: 📘 Critical Operations Interpretation

blocks.zh: ⚠️ Legacy Products 的除菌過濾驗證盲點
blocks.en: ⚠️ Blind Spot in Sterile Filtration Validation for Legacy Products

blocks.zh: FDA 特別點名要注意舊產品（Legacy Products）——這些是早期未提交藥物申請的老產品，可能從未進行正式的除菌過濾驗證。
blocks.en: FDA specifically calls out legacy products: older products marketed without a submitted drug application, for which formal sterile filtration validation may never have been performed.

blocks.zh: 查廠時，FDA 會確認：
blocks.en: During an inspection, FDA will confirm that:

blocks.zh: 實際使用的過濾器型號與驗證研究（及 NDA/ANDA 申請）完全一致
blocks.en: The filter actually used is exactly the same as in the validation study (and in the NDA/ANDA application)

blocks.zh: 操作參數上下限均在驗證範圍內
blocks.en: The upper and lower limits of the operating parameters are all within the validated range

blocks.zh: 舊產品是否有補充驗證記錄
blocks.en: Supplementary validation records exist for legacy products

blocks.zh: 參數放行（Parametric Release）的特殊地位
blocks.en: The Special Status of Parametric Release

blocks.zh: 參數放行是用滅菌製程控制數據取代最終無菌測試作為放行依據。條件：
blocks.en: Parametric release uses sterilization process control data in place of final sterility testing as the basis for release. Conditions:

blocks.zh: 僅限熱滅菌的最終滅菌產品（不適用無菌加工）
blocks.en: Limited to terminally sterilized products that undergo heat sterilization (not applicable to aseptic processing)

blocks.zh: 必須在藥物申請中獲得 FDA 批准
blocks.en: Must be approved by FDA in the drug application

blocks.zh: 須符合 FDA CPG Section 490.200 的所有條件
blocks.en: Must meet all conditions of FDA CPG Section 490.200

blocks.zh: 查廠時，未經批准即進行參數放行是嚴重缺失。
blocks.en: During an inspection, performing parametric release without approval is a serious deficiency.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 100% 目視檢查的查廠重點
blocks.en: ⚠️ Inspection Focus for 100% Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: FDA 對目視檢查的要求不只是「有做」，而是：
blocks.en: FDA's expectation for visual inspection goes beyond simply "having done it". It requires:

blocks.zh: 人員資格：有使用參考樣品（Reference Samples）進行資格確認
blocks.en: Personnel qualification: Qualification using reference samples

blocks.zh: 速率挑戰：查廠官員可能現場挑戰（challenge）目視檢查速率——確認操作員在實際速率下仍能識別缺陷
blocks.en: Rate challenge: Investigators may challenge the inspection rate on the spot to confirm that operators can still identify defects at the actual rate

blocks.zh: 自動化設備：對每種容器類型（透明瓶、琥珀瓶、有色溶液、懸浮劑）均需完成設備確認
blocks.en: Automated equipment: Equipment qualification must be completed for each container type (clear vials, amber vials, colored solutions, suspensions)

blocks.zh: Action Level：缺陷數量達到 Action Level 時的處置程序必須書面化
blocks.en: Action Level: The procedure to follow when the number of defects reaches the Action Level must be documented

blocks.zh: 💡 Clean Steam 的內毒素測試
blocks.en: 💡 Endotoxin Testing of Clean Steam

blocks.zh: Clean Steam（潔淨蒸氣）用於橡皮塞蒸氣滅菌，FDA 要求潔淨蒸氣本身必須測試內毒素。理由：若潔淨蒸氣含有內毒素，在滅菌過程中可能污染已清洗的橡皮塞，造成最終產品超過內毒素限度。這是容易被忽略的上游控制點。
blocks.en: Clean steam is used for steam sterilization of rubber stoppers, and FDA requires that the clean steam itself be tested for endotoxin. The rationale: if clean steam contains endotoxin, it can contaminate the washed stoppers during sterilization, causing the final product to exceed the endotoxin limit. This is an easily overlooked upstream control point.

blocks.zh: 🏭 生產系統查廠準備要點
blocks.en: 🏭 Key Preparation Points for Production System Inspection

blocks.zh: Media Fill 匯總：上次查廠以來所有 APS 批次記錄（按線別、班次），含干預記錄和結果
blocks.en: Media fill summary: Records of all APS runs since the last inspection (by line and shift), including intervention records and results

blocks.zh: 過濾器驗證矩陣：所有產品 × 過濾器型號，確認一致性；Legacy Product 需特別確認
blocks.en: Filter validation matrix: All products × filter types, to confirm consistency; legacy products need special confirmation

blocks.zh: 除熱原驗證報告：3-log 內毒素減少確認，含重新驗證觸發條件
blocks.en: Depyrogenation validation report: Confirmation of a 3-log endotoxin reduction, including revalidation triggers

blocks.zh: 凍乾機裝載記錄：含環境監控和人員監控數據，確認 ISO 5 保護的文件記錄
blocks.en: Lyophilizer loading records: Including environmental monitoring and personnel monitoring data, as documented evidence of ISO 5 protection

blocks.zh: 目視檢查 SOP 和人員資格記錄：含 Reference Set、速率設定依據
blocks.en: Visual inspection SOP and personnel qualification records: Including the reference set and the basis for the rate setting

blocks.zh: Clean Steam 內毒素測試記錄：確認有定期測試計畫和記錄
blocks.en: Clean steam endotoxin test records: Confirm that a periodic testing plan and records exist

blocks.zh: 批次記錄中的干預記錄：所有計畫外干預均已記錄並評估
blocks.en: Intervention records in batch records: All unplanned interventions have been recorded and evaluated

blocks.zh: Media Fill 頻率與規模的要求
blocks.en: Media Fill Frequency and Size Requirements

blocks.zh: 核心原則：Media Fill 設計必須真實反映最壞情況操作，包含所有代表性干預。
blocks.en: Core principle: The media fill design must realistically reflect worst-case operations, including all representative interventions.

blocks.zh: 除熱原驗證：3-log vs 6-log
blocks.en: Depyrogenation Validation: 3-log vs 6-log

blocks.zh: 注意：除熱原（Depyrogenation）驗證針對內毒素；Isolator 去污驗證針對微生物（BI）——兩者標準和對象不同。
blocks.en: Note: Depyrogenation validation targets endotoxin, whereas isolator decontamination validation targets microorganisms (BI). The standards and targets of the two differ.

blocks.zh: 📌 本節重點摘要 Section Summary — 3.7–3.8
blocks.en: 📌 Section Summary: 3.7-3.8

blocks.zh: WFI 六大查廠重點：死角、坡度、Alert/Action Level 設定依據、採樣計畫代表性、即時 TOC/電導度監控、趨勢分析與超標調查
blocks.en: Six key WFI inspection points: Dead legs, slope, basis for setting Alert/Action Levels, representativeness of the sampling plan, real-time TOC/conductivity monitoring, and trend analysis with excursion investigation

blocks.zh: CCI 取代無菌測試：需驗證 CCI 方法靈敏度，並在穩定性測試中持續確認
blocks.en: CCI replacing sterility testing: The sensitivity of the CCI method must be validated and continuously confirmed in stability testing

blocks.zh: 進廠密封件責任：採購預洗塞不免除藥廠責任——需廠商資格確認和定期驗收測試
blocks.en: Responsibility for incoming closures: Purchasing pre-washed stoppers does not relieve the firm of responsibility; vendor qualification and periodic acceptance testing are needed

blocks.zh: 媒體填充頻率：每線每班次每半年；人工操作需近商業批次規模；Isolator 可比例降低
blocks.en: Media fill frequency: Every line, every shift, every six months; manual operations need near-commercial batch size; isolators may use a reduced scale

blocks.zh: Legacy Products：除菌過濾驗證需確認與申請文件中過濾器型號完全一致
blocks.en: Legacy products: Sterile filtration validation must confirm that the filter type is exactly the same as in the application documents

blocks.zh: 除熱原 3-log：WFI 洗滌橡皮塞需達內毒素 3-log 減少（vs Isolator 去污 6-log 微生物）
blocks.en: Depyrogenation 3-log: Stoppers washed with WFI must achieve a 3-log endotoxin reduction (vs the 6-log microbial reduction for isolator decontamination)

blocks.zh: Clean Steam 測試：用於塞子滅菌的潔淨蒸氣必須測試內毒素
blocks.en: Clean steam testing: Clean steam used to sterilize stoppers must be tested for endotoxin

blocks.zh: 參數放行：僅限熱滅菌最終滅菌產品；必須有 FDA 批准的藥物申請
blocks.en: Parametric release: Limited to heat-sterilized terminally sterilized products; an FDA-approved drug application is required

blocks.zh: 目視檢查挑戰：查廠官員可現場挑戰檢查速率；人員資格需含參考樣品確認
blocks.en: Visual inspection challenge: Investigators may challenge the inspection rate on the spot; personnel qualification must include reference sample confirmation

blocks.zh: 現場觀察不可替代：生產系統查廠核心是即時觀察，文件查核不足以評估操作合規性
blocks.en: Direct observation is irreplaceable: The core of a production system inspection is real-time observation; a document review is not enough to assess operational compliance
